remarks: Pristine 4-Bedroom Home with Private Backyard Available for Rent! This fully renovated single-family home features four bedrooms and three bathrooms, with modern finishes throughout. The first floor includes a sleek kitchen with quartz countertops and stainless steel appliances, a spacious living room with a cozy fireplace, and a full bathroom. The second floor contains a sunny primary suite, three additional bedrooms, and two updated bathrooms. Oak hardwood floors, gas heating, and an energy-efficient on-demand hot water system contribute to the home's comfort. Outside, the private and secluded backyard provides an ideal space for entertaining or relaxing outdoors. A detached garage adds additional convenience. Conveniently located near I-95 (Exit 9), Glenbrook train station, shopping, and dining. Exterior cameras in use.
